therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Reduction of androgen excess effects on adipocyte dysfunction
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Lipid Content of PCOS Subcutaneous Abdominal Adipocytes Matured in Vitro

results.effect_size: Mean Difference (Final Values) = 1.12 fluorescence units/cell number
biomarker_changes: Flutamide reduced lipid content in adipocytes from 5.6 to 3.8 fluorescence units/cell
Placebo reduced lipid content from 2.0 to 1.37 fluorescence units/cell
Flutamide reduced total cholesterol by 16.0 mg/dL vs 1.7 mg/dL increase with placebo
safety_signals: No participants experienced elevated liver transaminases
No participants had severe depression risk
results.dose_information: Flutamide 125 mg orally each 28 day cycle for 6 cycles

context.investigator_commentary: The 125 mg oral dose of flutamide was specifically chosen because it has not been associated with liver enzyme abnormalities while being as effective as high dose flutamide in improving androgenic symptoms
